hypotheses.C1_hard_routed20_matches_fixed68: A hard-selected raw-4 plus tail-16 expert has mean exact KL at most 110% of fixed raw-4 plus tail-64 on every corpus.
hypotheses.C2_hard_routed20_beats_fixed20: Hard routing lowers mean exact KL by at least 20% relative to fixed raw-4 plus tail-16 on every corpus.
hypotheses.C3_router_closes_oracle_gap: Hard routing closes at least 70% of the mean-KL gap between fixed rank 20 and the per-example oracle expert on every corpus.
hypotheses.C4_hard_retains_soft_gain: Hard routing retains at least 80% of the soft router's gain over fixed rank 20 on every corpus.
hypotheses.C5_router_uses_multiple_experts: Hard routing has effective expert support at least three on every corpus.
hypotheses.C6_context_assignment_matters: Shuffling hard assignments raises mean exact KL by at least 25% on every corpus.
hypotheses.C7_context_beats_position_only: Hard context routing lowers mean exact KL by at least 20% relative to a frozen position-only route on every corpus.
hypotheses.C8_oracle_experts_are_near_sufficient: The per-example oracle expert reaches median exact KL at most 0.02 on every corpus.
hypotheses.C9_full_union_upper_bound: The orthogonalized union of the four trained experts has lower mean exact KL than every rank-20 fixed or routed method on every corpus.
